title: pr land hands its conflicts to the branch's worker and lands again
notes: Retro 2026-11-26: after pr land existed, it was refused for merge conflicts 6 times in the dashboard main session (parallel PRs touching work-card-skill.ts, dispatch.ts, docs decisions ids). Each time main relayed the conflict to the worker by hand, about 10-15 minutes and a full CI run each. When pr land finds conflicts with its base, it sends /pr-conflicts <n> to the pane working that branch (or starts one on the card) and, once its new head is green, lands it, without a main turn. Also consider board ship warning when a card in Doing already changes the same files.

comments.body: From main: #380 (merged) added pr create/ready/comment in src/main/command/pull-request-write-cli.ts and the shared retry in gh-answer.ts; reuse them. #383 (open, pane status) and #384 (open, heavy-run wait) are in flight; #384 touches work-card-skill.ts and review.ts.
